Section:NewButton("Reset and sit", "ButtonInfo", function()
    print("Clicked")

-- Reset Character + Sit GUI
-- Place in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "CharacterControls"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function createButton(name, text, position, callback)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Name = name
    button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 45)
    button.Position = position
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 120, 255)
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    button.Text = text
    button.TextSize = 16
    button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    button.Parent = screenGui

    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    corner.Parent = button

    button.Activated:Connect(callback)
end

-- Reset Character button
createButton(
    "ResetButton",
    "Reset Character",
    UDim2.new(1, -165, 0, 15),
    function()
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.Health = 0
        end
    end
)

-- Sit button
createButton(
    "SitButton",
    "Sit",
    UDim2.new(1, -165, 0, 70),
    function()
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then

        end
    end
)

end)
